added.summary: Svelte's draw on an SVG shape strokes it on (or off) over the outline's length, with duration, delay and easing (default cubicInOut). speed is refused: give duration.

fixed.summary: Svelte's blur now blurs the subtree through CSS filter: blur()'s layer from amount px (default 5), not opacity only. Presence and state values take the new props blur (CSS px) and draw (0 drawn whole, 1 hidden).
